description: Unit test code for the unknown payload decoder in HTTP/2 frame decoding, testing handling of unsupported frame types with various payload lengths.

classes.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides access to the current unknown frame type and flags affecting payload decoding for testing.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Collects frame parts during decoding, handling unknown frame start, payload, and end events.

classes.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Parameterized test class for testing unknown payload decoder with various payload lengths.

methods.name: FrameType
methods.description: Returns the current unknown frame type.

methods.name: FlagsAffectingPayloadDecoding
methods.description: Returns flags that affect payload decoding, always zero in this context.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles the start of an unknown frame, logs and forwards the event.

methods.name: OnUnknownPayload
methods.description: Handles payload data of an unknown frame, logs and forwards the data.

methods.name: OnUnknownEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an unknown frame, logs and forwards the event.

methods.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderTest
methods.description: Sets up tests with various payload lengths and random unsupported frame types.
